name: Station DC bus-tie operating interface
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Identifies the command and conditions associated with the selected DC bus connection.
description: Identifies the command and conditions associated with the selected DC bus connection. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “DC tie command and states” at the input and “Assigned bus-tie action” at the output. DC-source compatibility must be assessed.

Identify every source, protective device, isolation boundary and return. Battery capacity, DC fault duty, charging settings and ventilation require the selected battery-system design; illustrative circuits do not establish autonomy. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
